## Greetings!

I am an R/Shiny Developer My passion for R sparked when I felt frustrated of the mundane workflow at a previous job from SAS/Excel and knew there had to be a better way. I took an online programming class and immediately applied what I learned to my job.

Since then, I've built a few R packages, developed Shiny web apps, and automated long reports. I am a contributor to two CRAN packages: {echarts4r} and {USAboundaries}.

When I'm not coding, I enjoy graphing my coffee roasts, playing strategy board games, and cycling.
